paragraphs: DFIN is a leading global provider of compliance and regulatory software and services, supporting its clients' complex capital markets transactions and essential financial reporting at every stage of the corporate lifecycle and fueling end-to-end investment company regulatory compliance needs. The Company provides regulatory filing and deal solutions via its software, technology-enabled services and print and distribution solutions to public and private companies, mutual funds and other regulated investment firms, to serve its clients' regulatory and compliance needs. DFIN helps its clients comply with applicable regulations where and how they want to work in a digital world, providing numerous solutions tailored to each client's business needs. The prevailing trend is toward clients choosing to utilize the Company's software solutions, in conjunction with its tech-enabled services, to meet their document and filing needs, while at the same time shifting away from physical print and distribution of documents, except for when it is still regulatorily required or requested by clients.

The Company serves its clients' regulatory and compliance needs throughout their respective life cycles. For its capital markets clients, the Company offers solutions that allow companies to comply with U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC") regulations and support their corporate financial transactions and regulatory/financial reporting through the use of digital document creation and online content management tools; filing agent services, where applicable; solutions to facilitate clients' communications with their investors; and virtual data rooms and other deal management solutions. For investment companies clients, the Company provides solutions that allow investment companies to comply with SEC regulations and support financial and regulatory reporting through the use of content management and technology-enabled solutions for creating, compiling and filing regulatory communications as well as digital-driven solutions for distributing content to investors.

Technological advancements, regulatory changes, and evolving workflow preferences have led to the Company's clients managing more of the financial disclosure process themselves, changing the marketplace for the Company's services and products. DFIN's strategy in its Software Solutions segments (CM-SS and IC-SS, as defined below) aligns with the changing marketplace by focusing the Company's resources in its advanced software solutions, primarily ActiveDisclosure® ("ActiveDisclosure"), Arc Suite® software platform ("Arc Suite") and Venue® Virtual Data Room ("Venue"), while making targeted investments to further enhance product features. In its Compliance & Communications Management segments (CM-CCM and IC-CCM, as defined below), the Company's strategy focuses on maintaining its market-leading position by offering a high-touch, service-oriented experience, using its unique combination of tech-enabled services and print and distribution capabilities.

On October 1, 2016, DFIN became an independent publicly traded company through the distribution by R.R. Donnelley & Sons Company ("RRD") of shares of DFIN common stock to RRD stockholders (the "Separation"). Since the Separation, the Company has primarily grown organically, focusing resources on software solutions development and making targeted investments to further enhance product features.

The Company provides software solutions, tech-enabled services and print and distribution solutions to public and private companies for deal solutions and compliance to companies that are, or are preparing to become, subject to the filing and reporting requirements of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "Securities Act") and the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"). The Company supports clients primarily in North America, Europe and Asia. Capital markets clients leverage the Company's software offerings, proprietary technology, deep industry expertise and experience to successfully navigate the SEC's specified file formats when submitting documents through the SEC's Electronic Data Gathering, Analysis, and Retrieval ("EDGAR") system for their transactional and ongoing compliance needs.

The Company assists its capital markets clients throughout the course of initial public offerings ("IPOs"), secondary offerings, mergers and acquisitions ("M&A"), public and private debt offerings, leveraged buyouts, spinouts, special purpose acquisition companies ("SPAC") and subsequent de-SPAC transactions and other similar transactions. In addition, the Company provides clients with compliance solutions to prepare their ongoing required Exchange Act filings that are compatible with the SEC's EDGAR system, most notably Form 10-K, Form 10-Q, Form 8-K and proxy filings. These solutions include the Company's traditional full-service EDGAR filing preparation and filing agent services, tech-enabled services and print and distribution solutions as well as the Company's software solutions, ActiveDisclosure, predominantly a compliance solution, and Venue, predominantly a transactional solution.

In 2025, approximately 44% of capital markets net sales related to software solutions, of which approximately 62% related to Venue and approximately 38% related to ActiveDisclosure. In 2025, tech-enabled services and print and distribution solutions accounted for approximately 56% of capital markets net sales, of which approximately 59% were transactional in nature and approximately 41% were compliance in nature. In 2024, approximately 40% of capital markets net sales related to software solutions, of which approximately 65% related to Venue and approximately 35% related to ActiveDisclosure. In 2024, tech-enabled services and print and distribution solutions accounted for approximately 60% of capital markets net sales, of which approximately 55% were transactional in nature and approximately 45% were compliance in nature.

The Company helps capital markets clients throughout the course of public and private business transactions via its full-service traditional services and its software solutions, Venue and ActiveDisclosure. The Company supports deal participants in creating transaction-related registration statements, proxy statements and prospectuses, filing client documents as their filing agent through the SEC's EDGAR filing system and managing print for distribution to investors. The Company also provides registration statement, prospectus preparation and filing services through ActiveDisclosure and data room and secure file sharing through Venue.

The Company's Venue solution is a highly secure ISO/IEC 27001:2013-certified data room platform that allows clients to share confidential information in real-time throughout the transaction lifecycle. Clients can also maintain control over sensitive data when conducting due diligence for M&A transactions, raising capital, dual-tracking an IPO or developing a document repository. Specifically, companies have used Venue to securely organize, manage, distribute and track corporate governance, financing, legal and other documents in an online workspace accessible to internal and outside advisors. Venue allows clients to analyze documents to help them better understand their content as well as mitigate risk through the use of Venue's auto-redaction capability which protects personally identifiable information using efficient, secure and systematically burned-in redaction. The Company also engages third parties to perform annual SOC2 Type II compliance audits and penetration/vulnerability testing.

In 2025, the Company introduced a new Venue, which delivers a modern architecture, streamlined navigation, intelligent permissioning and real-time insights to speed up due diligence and simplify collaboration for M&A, capital raising and IPO transactions. The new Venue is designed to simplify and expedite the deal process for investment banking, legal and corporate teams. Venue enables users to self-launch new data rooms and manage multiple data rooms on demand, reducing reliance on IT resources and accelerating project timelines. The platform supports large file uploads and high-capacity storage designed to accommodate complex, data-heavy transactions such as M&A, IPOs and other corporate initiatives. The new Venue connects to the Company's broader software solutions, including ActiveDisclosure, to streamline SEC filings as well as financial reporting.

The Company offers around-the-clock services to support the transaction process, production platform and service delivery. Clients utilize the range of options available to them, including a hybrid approach with working group members participating both virtually and in-person during drafting sessions for their transactions or a fully-virtual experience. While the Company has significantly reduced its private conferencing facilities footprint, the service helps clients maintain confidentiality in deal negotiations and provides clients a place to host in-person working groups to meet, strategize and prepare documents for the transaction deal stream.

The Company provides compliance solutions to capital markets clients in preparing the Exchange Act filings that are compatible with the SEC's EDGAR system via its full-service traditional services and ActiveDisclosure. Capital markets clients leverage the Company's deep industry expertise and experience to successfully navigate the SEC's specified file formats when submitting compliance documents through the SEC's EDGAR system.

The Company's cloud-based product, ActiveDisclosure, provides features such as built-in collaboration tools and Inline eXtensible Business Reporting Language ("iXBRL") client-tagging capability. ActiveDisclosure provides capital markets clients with end-to-end solutions to collaborate, tag, validate and file with the SEC. By leveraging its software platform, ActiveDisclosure brings teams together across departments, functions and geographies in real time to create and edit filings and other documents across devices, simultaneously, while providing detailed audit trails for tracking every change made and employing interactive notifications for important tasks or comments. ActiveDisclosure utilizes native Microsoft Excel reporting capabilities of financial consolidation systems to seamlessly flow changes throughout an entire document automatically, reducing risk and providing additional assurance to clients. The Company employs stringent data security and privacy practices to provide that information is encrypted. ActiveDisclosure is ISO/IEC 27001:2013-certified, and the Company also engages third parties to perform annual SOC2 Type II compliance audits and penetration/vulnerability testing.

The Company helps capital markets clients elevate their proxy filings from compliance documents to investor-focused strategic communications tools with Proxy Design services. The Company's end-to-end proxy solutions include advisory services, proxy strategy and design, disclosure management, SEC EDGAR filing and expertise, online hosting solutions, print production, distribution and annual meeting services. Through a strategic relationship, the Company can also simplify and facilitate the annual meeting and proxy process for its capital markets clients through the deployment of project management services and state-of-the-art voting and tabulation technology. This arrangement allows the Company to provide end-to-end annual and special meeting services, from fulfillment and distributions of proxy materials, to the centralization of communications for all investors, to hosting of virtual stockholder meetings and tabulation of voting results.

headings: The Company's business may be adversely affected if it fails to adapt to technological changes and address the changing demands of clients, including those related to AI.
In the event of a material disruptive event, the Company's disaster recovery and business continuity plans may fail, which could adversely interrupt operations.
If the Company is unable to protect its proprietary technology and other rights, the value of DFIN's business and its competitive position may be impaired.
Business, Economic, Market and Operating Risks

A substantial part of the Company's business depends on clients continuing their use of DFIN's services and products. Any decline in the Company's client retention would harm the Company's future operating results.
The highly competitive market for DFIN's services and products, clients' budgetary constraints and industry fragmentation may create adverse price dynamics.
The Company may be unable to hire and retain talented employees, including management.
The Company's reliance on strategic relationships as part of its business strategy may adversely affect the development of DFIN's business in those areas.
The trend of increasing costs to provide health care and other benefits to employees and retirees may continue.
DFIN's business is dependent upon brand recognition and reputation, and the failure to maintain or enhance the Company's brand or reputation would likely have an adverse effect on its business.
There are risks associated with operations outside the United States.
The Company may become liable for funding obligations arising from multi-employer pension plans ("MEPP") obligations of the Company's former affiliates.
The Company's indebtedness may adversely affect the Company's business and results of operations, financial position and cash flows.
The agreements and instruments that govern the Company's debt impose restrictions that may limit the Company's operating and financial flexibility.
The Company may be able to incur significantly more debt.
Adverse credit market conditions may limit the Company's ability to obtain future financing.
The Company is exposed to risks related to potential adverse changes in currency exchange rates.
The future sale of shares of the Company's common stock may negatively affect the stock price.
The Company's management, subject to the Board's oversight in certain circumstances, has broad discretion in the use of its existing cash resources and may not use such funds effectively.
Modifications in the rules and regulations to which clients or potential clients are subject to may impact the demand for the Company's services and products offerings.
Increasing regulatory focus on privacy issues and expanding laws could impact DFIN's software solutions and expose the Company to increased liability.
paragraphs: The Company's consolidated results of operations, financial position and cash flows can be adversely affected by various risks. These risks include the principal factors listed below and other matters set forth in the Annual Report. You should carefully consider all of these risks.

The Company's failure to maintain the confidentiality, integrity and availability of its systems, software and solutions could seriously damage the Company's reputation and affect its ability to retain clients and attract new business.

Maintaining the confidentiality, integrity and availability of DFIN's systems, software and solutions is an issue of critical importance for the Company and its clients and users who rely on DFIN's systems to prepare regulatory filings and store and exchange large volumes of information, much of which is proprietary, confidential and may constitute material nonpublic information. Given DFIN's systems contain material nonpublic information about public reporting companies and potential M&A activities prior to its public release, the Company has been, and expects it will continue to be, a target of hacking or cybercrime. Inadvertent disclosure of the information maintained on DFIN's systems (or on the systems of the vendors on which the Company relies) due to human error, breach of the systems through hacking, cybercrime or a leak of confidential information due to employee misconduct, could seriously damage the Company's reputation, could cause it to expend significant resources responding to requests from government agencies and customers and could cause significant reputational harm for the Company and its clients. The Company's technologies, systems, networks and software have been and continue to be subject to cybersecurity threats and attacks, which range from uncoordinated individual attempts to sophisticated and targeted measures directed at the Company. The risk of a cybersecurity breach or disruption has increased as the number, intensity and sophistication of attempted attacks and intrusions from around the world have increased, including those utilizing AI capabilities, and the Company has in the past and may in the future be subject to security breaches.

The Company's customers and employees have been, and will continue to be, targeted by parties using fraudulent e-mails and other communications in attempts to misappropriate login credentials, including passwords, or to introduce viruses or other malware programs to its information systems, the information systems of its vendors or third-party service providers and/or its customers' computers. Though the Company endeavors to mitigate these threats through product improvements, use of encryption and authentication technology and customer and employee education, such cyber attacks against the Company or its vendors and third-party service providers remain a serious issue. Further, to access the Company's services and products, the Company's customers use their own electronic devices that are beyond DFIN's security control systems. Techniques used to obtain unauthorized access to, or to sabotage, systems change frequently and generally are not recognized until executed against a target. Similar to other software solutions, DFIN's software may be vulnerable to these types of attacks. Breaches and other inappropriate access can be difficult to detect and any delay in identifying them could increase their harm. An attack of this type could disrupt the proper functioning of the Company's software solutions, cause errors in the output of clients' work, allow unauthorized access to sensitive, proprietary or confidential information and other undesirable or destructive outcomes.

As a result of these types of risks and attacks, the Company has implemented and continuously reviews and updates systems, processes and procedures to protect against unauthorized access to or use of data and to prevent data loss. For example, the Company continues to refresh relevant security standards to reflect changes in current security threats, monitors DFIN systems for cyber threats, continues to update intrusion and detection capabilities and refreshes mandatory information security awareness training content, including awareness around phishing. However, the ever-evolving threats mean the Company and its third-party service providers and vendors must continually evaluate and adapt their respective systems and processes and overall security environment. There is no guarantee that these measures will be adequate to safeguard against all data security breaches, system compromises or misuses of data.

Furthermore, DFIN's systems allow the Company to share information that may be confidential in nature to its clients across the Company's offices and remote working locations worldwide. This design allows the Company to increase global reach for its clients and increase its responsiveness to client demands, but also increases the risk of a security breach or a leak of such information as it allows additional points of access to information by increasing the number of employees and facilities working on certain jobs. In addition, DFIN leverages third-party technology integrations across its systems, which facilitate analytics that inform strategic decisions, but exposes information to additional access points. Malicious software, sabotage, ransomware and other cybersecurity breaches of the types described above could cause an outage in DFIN's infrastructure, which could lead to a substantial delay of service and ultimately downtimes, recovery costs and client claims. The occurrence of an actual or perceived information leak or breach of security could cause the Company's reputation to suffer, clients to stop using DFIN's services and products offerings, the Company to have to respond to requests from government agencies and customers in connection with such event and the Company to face lawsuits and potential liability, any of which could cause DFIN's financial performance to be negatively impacted.

paragraphs: Net sales for the year ended December 31, 2025 decreased by $14.9 million, or 1.9%, to $767.0 million from $781.9 million for the year ended December 31, 2024, including a $0.8 million, or 0.1%, increase due to changes in foreign currency exchange rates. Net sales decreased primarily due to lower tech-enabled services net sales of $22.5 million, primarily driven by lower capital markets compliance volumes, and lower print and distribution net sales of $21.1 million, primarily driven by lower investment companies and capital markets compliance volumes, partially offset by higher software solutions net sales of $28.7 million, primarily due to higher ActiveDisclosure net sales of $12.7 million and higher Arc Suite net sales of $12.3 million.

Income from operations for the year ended December 31, 2025 increased by $4.5 million, or 3.3%, to $141.1 million from $136.6 million for the year ended December 31, 2024. Income from operations increased primarily due to lower cost of sales of $17.5 million and lower SG&A expenses of $13.0 million, partially offset by lower net sales of $14.9 million, as described above, a net gain of $9.8 million on the sale of land during the year ended December 31, 2024 and higher restructuring, impairment and other charges, net of $3.8 million. The lower cost of sales is largely driven by lower sales volumes, cost control initiatives and lower overhead costs, whereas the lower SG&A expenses are primarily driven by cost control initiatives, lower bad debt expense of $6.5 million, lower overhead costs and lower incentive compensation expense, partially offset by higher share-based compensation expense of $6.2 million and higher healthcare expense of $2.3 million.

headings: 市場波動/週期性與季節性
paragraphs: DFIN 是全球領先的合規與監管軟體及服務供應商，協助客戶在企業生命週期的各個階段處理複雜的資本市場交易與必要的財務報告，並滿足投資公司全面的監管合規需求。本公司透過其軟體、科技驅動服務及印刷與發行解決方案，為上市與非上市企業、共同基金及其他受監管投資公司提供服務，以滿足客戶的監管與合規需求。DFIN 協助客戶根據其在數位世界的運作方式，選擇合適的解決方案來符合相關法規，並提供多種針對每個客戶業務需求量身打造的解決方案。目前的趨勢是客戶傾向使用本公司的軟體解決方案，配合其科技驅動服務，以滿足其文件與申報需求，同時逐步減少對實體印刷與發行文件的依賴，除非法規要求或客戶特別要求。

本公司協助客戶在其各自生命週期中處理監管與合規需求。對於資本市場客戶，本公司提供解決方案，使企業能夠符合美國證券交易委員會（"SEC"）的法規，並透過數位文件創作與線上內容管理工具，支持其企業財務交易與監管/財務報告；提供文件申報代理服務（如適用）；協助客戶與投資者溝通的解決方案；以及虛擬資料室及其他交易管理解決方案。對於投資公司客戶，本公司提供解決方案，使投資公司能夠符合 SEC 法規，並透過內容管理與科技驅動解決方案，支持其財務與監管報告，包括用於創建、整理與提交監管溝通的解決方案，以及用於向投資者發送內容的數位驅動解決方案。

科技進步、法規變動及工作流程偏好的演變，使本公司的客戶更傾向自行管理財務披露流程，改變了本公司服務與產品的市場環境。DFIN 在其軟體解決方案分部（CM-SS 和 IC-SS，如後文所定義）的策略，與市場變化趨勢一致，透過聚焦於其先進軟體解決方案，如 ActiveDisclosure®（"ActiveDisclosure"）、Arc Suite® 軟體平台（"Arc Suite"）和 Venue® 虛擬資料室（"Venue"），同時進行針對性的投資以進一步提升產品功能。在合規與溝通管理分部（CM-CCM 和 IC-CCM，如後文所定義），本公司的策略著重於維持其市場領先地位，透過提供高接觸度、以服務為導向的體驗，並結合其獨特的科技驅動服務與印刷與發行能力。
2016 年 10 月 1 日，DFIN 透過 R.R. Donnelley & Sons Company（"RRD"）向 RRD 股東發放 DFIN 普通股，成為一家獨立上市的公司（"分拆"）。自分拆以來，本公司主要透過內生成長，專注於軟體解決方案的開發，並進行針對性的投資以進一步提升產品功能。

本公司為上市與非上市企業提供軟體解決方案、科技驅動服務及印刷與發行解決方案，以協助其處理交易解決方案與合規需求，這些企業或正在準備成為需遵守《1933 年證券法》（"Securities Act"）及《1934 年證券交易所法》（"Exchange Act"）申報與報告要求的公司。本公司主要服務客戶位於北美、歐洲及亞洲。資本市場客戶利用本公司的軟體解決方案、專有科技、深厚的產業專業知識與經驗，成功應對 SEC 規定的文件格式，以提交文件至 SEC 的電子資料蒐集、分析與檢索系統（"EDGAR"）以滿足其交易性與持續合規需求。

本公司協助資本市場客戶在首次公開發行（"IPOs"）、二次發行、併購（"M&A"）、公眾與私人債務發行、槓桿收購、分拆、特殊目的收購公司（"SPAC"）及隨後的去 SPAC 交易及其他類似交易的過程中。此外，本公司提供解決方案，協助客戶準備其持續的 Exchange Act 申報文件，這些文件與 SEC 的 EDGAR 系統相容，特別是 10-K 表格、10-Q 表格、8-K 表格及代理申報文件。這些解決方案包括本公司的傳統全服務 EDGAR 申報準備及申報代理服務、科技驅動服務及印刷與發行解決方案，以及本公司的軟體解決方案 ActiveDisclosure（主要為合規解決方案）和 Venue（主要為交易解決方案）。

2025 年，約 44% 的資本市場淨銷售額與軟體解決方案相關，其中約 62% 與 Venue 相關，約 38% 與 ActiveDisclosure 相關。2025 年，科技驅動服務及印刷與發行解決方案佔資本市場淨銷售額約 56%，其中約 59% 具交易性質，約 41% 具合規性質。2024 年，約 40% 的資本市場淨銷售額與軟體解決方案相關，其中約 65% 與 Venue 相關，約 35% 與 ActiveDisclosure 相關。2024 年，科技驅動服務及印刷與發行解決方案佔資本市場淨銷售額約 60%，其中約 55% 具交易性質，約 45% 具合規性質。

本公司透過其全服務傳統服務及軟體解決方案 Venue 和 ActiveDisclosure，協助資本市場客戶處理公眾與私人商業交易。本公司協助交易參與者創建與交易相關的註冊聲明、代理聲明與招股書，透過 SEC 的 EDGAR 申報系統作為客戶的申報代理提交客戶文件，並管理向投資者發行的印刷品。本公司也透過 ActiveDisclosure 提供註冊聲明與招股書準備及申報服務，並透過 Venue 提供資料室與安全文件分享服務。

本公司之Venue解決方案為一高度安全、經ISO/IEC 27001:2013認證之資料室平台，允許客戶在交易生命週期內即時分享機密資訊。客戶亦可在進行併購交易、籌資、雙軌進行上市或建立文件倉庫時，維持對敏感資料的控制。具體而言，公司已運用Venue來安全地組織、管理、分發與追蹤公司治理、融資、法律及其他文件於可讓內部與外部顧問存取的線上工作空間。Venue允許客戶分析文件以幫助他們更深入瞭解內容，並透過Venue的自動遮蔽功能來降低風險，該功能透過高效、安全且系統性地遮蔽的方式保護個人資訊。本公司亦聘請第三方進行年度SOC2 Type II合規稽核及滲透/漏洞測試。

2025年，本公司推出新版Venue，提供現代化架構、簡化導覽、智慧權限管理及即時洞察，以加速盡職調查並簡化併購、資金籌集及上市交易的協作。新版Venue設計用以簡化並加速投資銀行、法律及企業團隊的交易流程。Venue允許用戶自啟動新的資料室並按需管理多個資料室，減少對IT資源的依賴並加快專案時程。該平台支援大檔案上傳及高容量儲存，以適應複雜且資料密集型的交易，如併購、上市及其他企業計畫。新版Venue與本公司更廣泛的軟體解決方案連接，包括ActiveDisclosure，以簡化SEC申報及財務報告。
本公司提供全天候服務以支援交易流程、生產平台及服務交付。客戶會利用其可選的範圍，包括混合模式，讓工作小組成員在起草會議中同時以視訊及實體參與，或完全以虛擬方式進行。雖然本公司已大幅減少私人會議設施的規模，但該服務協助客戶在交易談判中維持機密性，並提供客戶一個舉辦實體工作小組會議的場地，以進行會談、策略規劃及準備交易文件。
本公司為資本市場客戶提供合規解決方案，以準備符合SEC EDGAR系統的交易所法規申報文件，透過其全功能傳統服務及ActiveDisclosure。資本市場客戶運用本公司深厚的產業專業知識與經驗，成功導航SEC指定的檔案格式，以提交合規文件至SEC EDGAR系統。

本公司之雲端產品ActiveDisclosure提供內建協作工具及Inline eXtensible Business Reporting Language（"iXBRL"）客戶標籤功能。ActiveDisclosure為資本市場客戶提供端到端解決方案，以協作、標籤、驗證並提交至SEC。透過運用其軟體平台，ActiveDisclosure讓跨部門、功能及地理區域的團隊實時協作，同時在不同裝置上建立與編輯申報文件及其他文件，並提供詳細的審計追蹤以追蹤每項變更，並運用互動式通知以處理重要任務或意見。ActiveDisclosure運用財務合併系統的原生Microsoft Excel報表功能，以自動流動整個文件的變更，降低風險並為客戶提供額外的保證。本公司採用嚴謹的資料安全與隱私權實踐，以確保資訊加密。ActiveDisclosure為ISO/IEC 27001:2013認證，本公司亦聘請第三方進行年度SOC2 Type II合規稽核及滲透/漏洞測試。

本公司協助資本市場客戶將其股東提案申報文件從合規文件提升為投資者導向的戰略溝通工具，透過Proxy Design服務。本公司之端到端股東提案解決方案包括諮詢服務、提案策略與設計、資訊揭露管理、SEC EDGAR申報及專業知識、線上 hosting 解決方案、列印生產、發行及年度股東大會服務。透過戰略合作關係，本公司亦可簡化並協助資本市場客戶進行年度股東大會及提案流程，透過專案管理服務及最先進的投票與計票技術的部署。此安排使本公司能提供端到端年度及特別股東大會服務，從履行與發行提案資料、集中所有投資者的溝通，至舉辦虛擬股東大會及計票投票結果。

paragraphs: 營業利益於2025年12月31日財年增加4.5 百萬美元，或3.3%，至141.1 百萬美元，較2024年12月31日財年136.6 百萬美元增加。營業利益增加主要由於銷售成本減少17.5 百萬美元以及營運及行政費用減少13.0 百萬美元，部分抵銷因上述淨銷售額減少14.9 百萬美元，以及2024年12月31日財年出售土地產生的淨獲利9.8 百萬美元，以及更高的重組、減損及其他費用淨額3.8 百萬美元。銷售成本減少主要因銷售量減少、成本控制措施及較低的間接費用，而營運及行政費用減少主要因成本控制措施、較低的呆帳費用6.5 百萬美元、較低的間接費用以及較低的績效獎金費用，部分抵銷因較高的股票選擇權費用6.2 百萬美元以及較高的醫療費用2.3 百萬美元。

headings: 本公司業務若無法適應科技變革並回應客戶需求的變化，包括與人工智慧相關的變化，可能會受到不利影響。
若發生重大幹擾事件，本公司災難復原與業務持續性計畫可能失敗，這可能會對營運造成不利影響。
若本公司無法保護其專屬科技及其他權利，DFIN 的業務價值及其競爭地位可能會受到損害。
業務、經濟、市場與營運風險
本公司業務的相當一部分取決於客戶持續使用 DFIN 的服務與產品。若本公司客戶留存率下降，將會損害本公司未來的營運成果。
DFIN 服務與產品的高競爭市場、客戶預算限制及產業碎片化可能會導致不利的價格動態。
本公司可能無法聘僱並留住優秀人才，包括管理層。
本公司對策略性關係的依賴，作為其業務策略的一部分，可能不利於DFIN在這些領域的業務發展。
提供員工及退休人員醫療保健及其他福利的成本增加趨勢可能持續。
DFIN的業務依賴品牌認知度與聲譽，若未能維持或提升本公司的品牌或聲譽，將可能對其業務產生不利影響。
在美國境外進行營運存在相關風險。
本公司可能因前子公司之多僱主退休金計畫（"MEPP"）義務而負起資金義務。
本公司的負債可能對其業務及營運成果、財務狀況與現金流產生不利影響。
規範本公司負債的契約及文據設有限制條款，可能限制本公司的營運與財務彈性。
本公司可能能夠負擔顯著更高的債務。
不利的信貸市場情況可能限制本公司的未來融資能力。
本公司面臨與潛在不利貨幣匯率變動相關的風險。
本公司普通股未來的發行可能會對股票價格產生負面影響。
本公司管理階層，在特定情況下受董事會監督，對現有現金資源的運用擁有廣泛的裁量權，且可能無法有效地運用這些資金。
客戶或潛在客戶所受規則與法規的變更可能影響本公司服務與產品的市場需求。
對隱私權問題的法規關注度增加及法律擴張可能影響DFIN的軟體解決方案，並使本公司面臨更高的法律責任風險。
paragraphs: 本公司的合併營運成果、財務狀況及現金流可能因各種風險而受到不利影響。這些風險包括下列主要因素及其他在年度報告中說明的事項。您應仔細考慮所有這些風險。
本公司未能維護其系統、軟體及解決方案的機密性、完整性與可用性，可能會嚴重損害本公司的聲譽，並影響其維持客戶與吸引新業務的能力。

維護DFIN系統、軟體及解決方案的機密性、完整性與可用性，對本公司及其客戶與使用者而言是極其重要的事項，這些客戶與使用者依賴DFIN系統準備監管申報文件，並儲存與交換大量資訊，其中許多資訊屬專屬、機密，且可能構成重大非公開資訊。由於DFIN系統包含有關公開申報公司的重大非公開資訊，以及在公開發佈前的潛在併購活動資訊，本公司已成為且預期將持續成為網路攻擊或網路犯罪的目標。因人為錯誤導致DFIN系統（或本公司所依賴的供應商系統）中資訊的非意圖性揭露，或因網路攻擊、網路犯罪或員工不當行為導致機密資訊外洩，可能會嚴重損害本公司的聲譽，並導致本公司需投入大量資源回應政府機構與客戶的請求，並對本公司及其客戶造成重大聲譽損害。本公司的技術、系統、網路與軟體已持續受到網路安全威脅與攻擊，這些威脅與攻擊範圍從無組織個別嘗試，到針對本公司的複雜且有針對性的措施不等。隨著來自世界各地的攻擊與入侵數量、強度與複雜度增加，包括利用AI能力的攻擊，網路安全漏洞或中斷的風險也隨之增加，本公司過去及未來可能遭受安全漏洞的影響。

本公司客戶與員工已成為並持續成為使用欺詐電子郵件及其他通訊方式的當事人目標，這些當事人試圖竊取登入憑證（包括密碼），或引入病毒或其他惡意軟體至本公司的資訊系統、供應商資訊系統或第三方服務供應商的資訊系統，以及客戶的電腦。儘管本公司透過產品改進、使用加密與認證技術及客戶與員工教育來緩解這些威脅，但針對本公司或其供應商與第三方服務供應商的網路攻擊仍是一個嚴重問題。此外，為使用本公司的服務與產品，本公司客戶使用其自己的電子設備，這些設備在DFIN的安全控制系統範疇之外。用來取得未經授權訪問或破壞系統的技術頻繁變更，通常在對目標執行後才被識別。與其他軟體解決方案類似，DFIN的軟體可能對這些類型的攻擊有漏洞。資料外洩或其他未經授權訪問可能難以察覺，任何延遲識別這些事件都可能增加其損害。這種類型的攻擊可能幹擾本公司軟體解決方案的正常運作，導致客戶工作輸出錯誤，允許未經授權訪問敏感、專屬或機密資訊，以及其他不希望或破壊性的結果。

基於這些類型的風險與攻擊，本公司已實施並持續評估與更新系統、流程與程序，以防止未經授權訪問或使用資料，並防止資料遺失。例如，本公司持續更新相關安全標準，以反映當前安全威脅的變化，監測DFIN系統的網路威脅，持續更新入侵與偵測能力，並更新強制性的資訊安全意識培訓內容，包括反詐騙意識。然而，持續演變的威脅意味著本公司及其第三方服務供應商與供應商必須持續評估與適應其各自的系統與流程及整體安全環境。這些措施無法保證足以防範所有資料安全漏洞、系統遭入侵或資料被誤用的風險。

此外，DFIN的系統允許本公司與客戶分享可能屬機密性的資訊，這些資訊透過本公司各辦事處與全球遠端工作地點進行分享。這種設計使本公司能增加客戶的全球覆蓋範圍，並提升對客戶需求的回應能力，但也增加了資訊遭竊取或洩漏的風險，因它增加了資訊的訪問點數量，進而增加處理特定工作的員工與設施數量。此外，DFIN透過第三方技術整合其系統，這些整合促進分析，以協助戰略決策，但也使資訊暴露於更多的訪問點。上述類型的惡意軟體、破壞、勒索軟體或其他網路安全漏洞可能導致DFIN基礎設施中斷，進而導致服務延遲，最終造成停機、恢復成本與客戶索賠。實際或被認為資訊洩漏或安全漏洞的發生，可能導致本公司聲譽受損，客戶停止使用DFIN的服務與產品，本公司需回應政府機構與客戶的相關請求，並面臨訴訟與潛在責任，任何情況都可能導致DFIN的財務表現受到負面影響。
